clauses.heading: Medically Necessary Surgical Expenses
clauses.text: Knee replacement surgery is covered as a medically necessary procedure under Section 4.2 of the policy wording subject to standard specific illness waiting periods.

clauses.heading: Pre-Existing Diseases Waiting Period
clauses.text: Waiting period of 36 months applies for pre-existing conditions and their direct complications. Pre-existing disease coverage commences only after 36 months of continuous active policy renewal.

clauses.heading: Cataract Treatment Sub-limit
clauses.text: Coverage for cataract surgery is limited to a maximum of ₹25,000 per eye inclusive of cost of intraocular lens.

clauses.heading: Specific Illness Waiting Period
clauses.text: Specific illness waiting period of 24 consecutive months of continuous coverage applies for cataract, hernia, joint replacement surgeries, and hydrocele.

clauses.heading: Room Rent and Proportionate Deductions
clauses.text: If the insured person occupies a room with room rent higher than the entitled limit (1% of Sum Insured per day), the insurer shall bear all associated medical expenses proportionately.

clauses.heading: Intensive Care Unit (ICU) Charges
clauses.text: ICU charges covered up to 2% of Sum Insured per day without proportionate deduction on doctor fees.

clauses.heading: Initial 30-Day Waiting Period
clauses.text: A 30-day waiting period from inception applies for all medical treatments other than accidental injury.

clauses.heading: Exclusions: Consumables & Non-Medical
clauses.text: Non-medical consumables, convenience charges, and luxury amenities are excluded under IRDAI guidelines (approx. 8% statutory deduction).

clauses.heading: Single Standard A/C Room Cover
clauses.text: The insured is eligible for a Single Standard A/C Room without proportionate deduction penalties across associated medical practitioner fees.

clauses.heading: Cataract Benefit
clauses.text: Cataract surgery is covered up to ₹50,000 per eye after continuous coverage of 24 months.

clauses.heading: Waiting Periods Schedule
clauses.text: Pre-existing conditions covered after 24 months. Specific diseases covered after 24 months. Initial waiting period of 30 days applies.

clauses.heading: Non-Medical Items Exclusion
clauses.text: Expenses incurred on non-medical items and toiletries shall not be admissible as per IRDAI list.

clauses.heading: Any Room Except Suite Eligibility
clauses.text: The insured person is entitled to occupy Any Room category except a Suite room with zero proportionate billing deduction.

clauses.heading: Restore Benefit & No Sub-limits
clauses.text: No sub-limits apply for cataract or joint replacement surgery; expenses are payable up to the Sum Insured.

clauses.heading: Waiting Periods
clauses.text: Initial waiting period 30 days. Pre-existing disease waiting period is 36 consecutive months.
